categories.name: Gungur
categories.tagline: A whisper of bells at every step

products.name: Gilded Drop Earrings
products.description: A slender gold drop that catches the light with every turn. Hand-polished brass with a soft champagne finish and a featherweight feel for all-day wear.

products.name: Pearl Petal Studs
products.description: Five ivory petals arranged around a single luminous pearl. A quiet, sculptural stud that moves easily from morning meetings to late dinners.

products.name: Champagne Hoop Earrings
products.description: An everyday hoop refined to a whisper-thin profile, brushed in champagne gold. Light enough to forget you are wearing them.

products.name: Ivory Tassel Earrings
products.description: Hand-knotted ivory silk tassels suspended from a fine gold cap. Movement, softness and a little drama for festive evenings.

products.name: Meenakari Bangle Set
products.description: A set of six slender bangles finished with hand-painted meenakari enamel in ivory and champagne. Stack them all or wear two at a time.

products.name: Champagne Kada
products.description: One solid kada with a softly hammered surface and a hidden hinge closure. A statement worn alone, a texture layered with others.

products.name: Ivory Resin Churi
products.description: Milky ivory resin with a band of gold leaf set inside. Impossibly light, endlessly stackable, and made for warm-weather dressing.

products.name: Heirloom Gold Churi
products.description: A bridal-weight pair inspired by heirloom Bengali goldwork, with fine filigree along the outer edge. Finished by hand in small batches.

products.name: Heritage Pearl Jumka
products.description: A classic dome silhouette lined with pearl drops and a delicate pearl fringe. Weighted to sit beautifully, designed to be remembered.

products.name: Rosewood Jumka
products.description: Carved rosewood discs edged in antique gold, suspended from a slim chain. Earthy, architectural and unexpectedly easy to wear.

products.name: Kundan Jumka
products.description: Traditional kundan stones set into a scalloped gold frame with pearl tips. Our most requested piece for wedding season.

products.name: Antique Ghungroo Jumka
products.description: Tiny ghungroo bells sway beneath an antiqued dome, giving a soft chime with movement. A piece with history in its silhouette.

products.name: Bell Charm Gungur
products.description: A band of small bells on a fine gold chain — the lightest way to bring sound into an outfit. Clasp adjustable to two lengths.

products.name: Vintage Gungur Set
products.description: Two gungur bands in graduated sizes with a softly aged finish. Worn at the wrist or ankle, they layer beautifully.

products.name: Pearl Gungur
products.description: Tiny pearls alternated with gold bells on a silk cord. Delicate in scale but generous in detail — a quiet heirloom.

products.name: Noir Gungur
products.description: Black onyx beads with brushed gold bells for a more modern, tonal look. Pairs beautifully with monochrome dressing.

products.name: Champagne Lariat Necklace
products.description: Two fine chains that fall at uneven lengths, finished with a single baroque pearl. Adjustable, effortless, endlessly flattering.

products.name: Pearl Cascade Necklace
products.description: Graduated ivory pearls that fall in a soft cascade along the collarbone. A bridal piece that photographs as beautifully as it feels.

products.name: Ivory Choker
products.description: A sculpted gold band wrapped in ivory enamel, sitting close to the throat. Minimal, architectural, and made for open necklines.

products.name: Heirloom Pendant Necklace
products.description: A hand-engraved pendant on a fine cable chain, inspired by antique Bengali jewellery boxes. Engraving available on request.

products.name: Artisan Chocolate Box
products.description: Twelve small-batch bonbons in dark, milk and champagne flavours, arranged in our signature ivory box. A gift that arrives ready to give.

products.name: Velvet Truffle Collection
products.description: Sixteen truffles dusted in cocoa and gold, with centres of salted caramel and pistachio praline. Keep cool, share slowly.

products.name: Date & Nut Chocolate Slab
products.description: A hand-broken slab of 70% dark chocolate studded with Medjool dates, almonds and a little sea salt. Wrapped in matte paper and tied with gold cord.

products.name: Signature Gift Hamper
products.description: Chocolate, a small jewellery piece and a hand-written card in a reusable ivory keepsake box. Our most gifted set of the season.

products.name: Bridal Ivory Set
products.description: Necklace, jumka and churi in a matched ivory-and-gold finish, designed for the bridal wardrobe. Presented in a lined keepsake case.

products.name: Champagne Celebration Set
products.description: Lariat necklace with matching drop earrings in a soft champagne finish. Everything you need for an evening, nothing you don't.

products.name: Heritage Jumka & Churi Set
products.description: Pearl jumka paired with a filigree churi stack, finished in the same antique gold tone. A festive pairing made to be handed down.

products.name: Minimal Daily Set
products.description: Petite studs, a fine chain and one slim bangle — the three pieces our team reaches for every morning. Made to be lived in.
